ruleDefinitions.name: Rar Usage with Password and Compression Level
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of rar.exe, on the command line, to create an archive with password protection or with a specific compression level. This is pretty indicative of malicious actions.

sequences.query: process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-hp.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ a\\ .*"))
